summary.prose: Building s1 means changing how the store writes relationships so none is lost, recording each repository's completeness, and surfacing it. The work starts in the store (three new tables, the migration, the per-repository state and the pending-row rules), moves to the indexer (the cross-file pass's modes and classes, re-exports, the reindex from scratch), then to the daemon's status replies, the CLI and both editor plugins and the analyzer, and ends with a reindex of this repository measured against the issue's caller counts.

testStrategyCoverage.lldStrategyItem: upsertResolvedRelations: both endpoints stored -> edge; target absent -> pending row of the same kind awaiting the target id (meta.awaitsId, class 'awaiting-target', indexed in unresolved_by_target); source absent -> unwritable 'source-missing' against meta.repo, or the daemon-wide unattributed counter when there is none; kind without byte -> unwritable 'unknown-kind' (src/db/__tests__/relations-awaiting-target.test.ts)
upsertUnresolvedRelations: row without meta.file/meta.repo and row of an unregistered repository counted unwritable with reason, not dropped

promoteToResolved and promoteResolvedBatch: absent target keeps the row rewritten to await the id (row NOT deleted); absent source deletes the stale row and counts it; returned {promoted, keptAwaiting, unwritable}
listUnresolvedRelations with opts.awaiting reads through unresolved_by_target; two rows awaiting one id are both returned

completenessOf: undefined state -> not complete with 'a reindex is needed'; each non-zero cause yields one reason line with its count; ambiguous and external-endpoint rows do not make the graph incomplete; complete = graphComplete when embeddingAvailable is false (src/db/__tests__/index-state.test.ts)
IndexState pending counts recounted on store open from each row's stored meta.class, with persisted fields carried over across closeGraphStore/reopen

TypeScript parser emits pending EXPORTS rows for `export { f } from`, `export { f as g } from` and `export * from` with rawTo, specifier and exportedAs (src/indexer/parser/__tests__/typescript-reexports.test.ts)
graphCompleteness with an incomplete repoCompleteness returns notEstablished with the repository's reasons in the basis note; with a complete one returns as today

transactional counts: a write transaction made to throw after its row writes leaves both the pending rows and the index_state counts unchanged; a store whose index_state counts are edited by hand is corrected on open from the stored classes with a warn log

resolveRelations: a relative IMPORTS of './missing.js' (no file on disk) is returned unresolved with meta.class 'no-candidate' and reason 'target-file-missing'; one of an existing file resolves to its file id as today; every resolved relation carries meta.repo
graphCompleteness: existing callers' arguments (returned, found, limited, skipped, partlyRead, rule) give the same Completeness as before; only repoCompleteness changes the result

updateUnresolvedMetaBatch merges meta (awaitsId and specifier survive a reclass) and moves the class counts; each of deleteUnresolvedForFile, deleteUnresolvedForRepoFile and deleteUnresolvedForRepo decrements the counts it removes (mutation check: the replace-meta behaviour restored loses awaitsId)

path form of kept-awaiting rows: a relation kept awaiting by upsertResolvedRelations (with and without its own meta.file), by a promotion and by a Pass 1 rewire is removed by deleteUnresolvedForFile(<absolute path>) and its count decremented; a DEPENDS_ON kept awaiting is removed only by deleteUnresolvedForRepo (mutation check: building meta.file from the entity row's repo-relative filePath leaves the row and the test fails)

ac1 fixture: a.ts imports and calls b.ts's fn (a sorts before b); a first full index stores the IMPORTS and the CALLS, findCallers(fn) returns a.ts's call site, and IndexState reads complete (src/indexer/__tests__/first-index-order.test.ts)

re-export fixture: c.ts calls f() imported from index.ts which does `export { f } from './b'`; plus `export { f as g } from './b'` with a call g(), a barrel of a barrel, `export * from`, and a two-file re-export cycle; findCallers(f) returns the call sites through the barrel including g(), export_names holds (barrel, 'g') -> f, the stored EXPORTS edge value is empty, and the cycle terminates with the name left 'no-candidate' (src/indexer/__tests__/reexport-callers.test.ts)

runCrossFileResolver Pass 0: a pending row awaiting an id is promoted once the target's file is indexed, with committedFiles given (settle) and omitted (full index); counts in CrossFileResolveResult.completedById and pendingByClass

fullIndex reindex: a store with a deliberately lost cross-file edge (an edge deleted by hand, the file hashes unchanged) is rebuilt by repo.reindex with the edge back; the unchanged-hash skip does not apply; uncommittedFiles records a file whose parse throws; the repository entity is stored and a DEPENDS_ON edge is written for a two-repository manifest fixture

cross-repository restore (a guard; no indexer writes such an edge today, so the fixture WRITES A's CALLS edge into B's entity by hand with upsertRelations): B is reindexed while A is not; A's edge is returned to pending before B's delete and restored by B's 'full' Pass 0 through unresolved_by_target; A's counts return to zero awaiting; a forced failure of the return-to-pending transaction leaves B's rows and A's edge untouched
interruption: fullIndexFinished false after a full index made to throw part-way, and the daemon start-up path queues a full index for that repository

MIGRATION_V4_TO_V5 on a V4 store built with today's code: sub-DBs opened, an IndexState row with fullIndexFinished false per workspace repository, SCHEMA_VERSION 5 stored, earlier steps untouched; a failing run leaves the version at 4 (src/db/graph/__tests__/migration-v4-to-v5.test.ts)
repo.stats, repo.list and daemon.status handlers return completeness beside an unchanged four-value status (src/daemon/__tests__/repo-completeness.test.ts)

executor puts repoCompleteness on ExplorationRunnerContext; usage.example, import.graph, class.hierarchy, data-model.trace and convention.detect outputs read notEstablished with the counts for an incomplete repository (extends src/analyze/explore/__tests__/completeness-all-lookups.test.ts)

completeness and file-target classes, one fixture repository: imports of './missing.js', './logo.png', './vendor/lib.min.js' and a JSON over 256 KB read 'no-candidate' (reasons 'target-file-missing' / 'target-not-code') and the repository reads complete; adding an import of a .ts file in a directory the ignore list excludes makes it read not complete with the reason line '1 relationship points at files an ignore rule excludes'; an import of a .css file resolves to the stored file entity (mutation check: with the selection rule not applied, the .png import keeps the repository incomplete)

endpoint passes: a boundary relation kept with class 'external-endpoint' when its target is absent does not make the repository incomplete and is not promoted by Pass 0; external-endpoints and messaging-endpoints suites still pass with promoteResolvedBatch's new return
unattributed refusal: a resolved relation with no meta.repo and an unstored source increments DaemonStatus.unattributedUnwritable and no repository's state
settle: a file event that creates the target of awaiting rows; runSettlePass promotes them at the settle (mutation check: with committedFiles not passed they stay pending)
reconcile: resolveAfterReconcile runs in 'repository' mode and leaves fullIndexFinished and the classes a full index set unchanged

one row per relationship: a raw-name row re-keyed by a promotion that keeps it awaiting, then the same relationship written through upsertResolvedRelations' keep-awaiting branch, leaves one row and an awaiting-target count of 1 (mutation check: re-keying removed gives 2)
meta.repo on Pass 1's import rewire: a refused rewire is counted against the repository, not the unattributed counter

the executor sets repoCompleteness at all three context constructions in executor.ts, and each of the five relationship lookups reports notEstablished for an incomplete repository (extends completeness-all-lookups.test.ts; mutation check: one construction left without it fails)
repo.remove leaves no index_state row, export_names entry or unresolved_by_target entry for the removed repository, and a store reopened afterwards does not recount it
settle: a file event adds a file importing './logo.png'; after the settle the row is 'no-candidate' with reason 'target-not-code', by the same rule the full index applies

unreadable file: a selected file whose read fails during a full index (removed between listing and read via an injected listing, or with its permissions removed) is in uncommittedFiles and the repository reads not complete (mutation check: with only thrown errors recorded, the test fails)

completeness after a settle: in a repository that reads complete, a file event adds a call to `JSON.parse` and to an unknown library function; after the settle both rows are 'no-candidate' (reason 'no-match') and the repository still reads complete (mutation check: with Pass 2 leaving UNRESOLVED rows unclassed outside 'full' mode, it reads incomplete and the test fails)

export_names upkeep: re-index a barrel (content changed) and then delete it; after each, no export_names entry remains under its old u64, and after the re-index the entries under the new u64 resolve calls as before (mutation check: without the cleanup in detachDeleteEntitiesInTxn, an entry remains and the test fails)

RepoCompleteness shape in src/shared/types.ts matches the mirrored DTOs: vscode-plugin daemon-gateway type and JetBrains RepoStatsDto deserialization (a JSON fixture of a repo.stats reply decoded by each plugin's existing test harness)
CLI ReposPane RepoRow renders 'incomplete' with the count beside the status for an incomplete repository and nothing extra for a complete one (ink-testing-library render)
VS Code Daemon tab lists the repositories with status and completeness (webview source test plus a headless-Chrome screenshot per the webview visual verification recipe)

VS Code: RepoRef carries completeness from registeredRepos, and the Daemon tab renderer in detail-renderers.ts lists each repository with status and completeness (webview source test plus a headless-Chrome screenshot read by eye)
before: record findCallers counts for runGrepSearch (expected 0 today) and stripReviewSection (1 today) and the grep counts (4 and 4)
before the reindex: record the count of pending rows by kind for this repository (today's store holds no class)

repo.reindex of this repository without removing it; after it ends: runGrepSearch has 4 callers outside test files (src/daemon/tools/builtins/search/grep.ts:222, probe.ts:62, config-trace.ts:104, search-text.ts:104) and stripReviewSection has 4 (start.ts:72, findings.ts:90 and verdicts.ts:92 through src/workflow/review/index.ts, run-artifact.ts:84)

after the reindex: repo.stats for this repository reports the four class counts (awaiting-target, ambiguous, no-candidate, external-endpoint) and unwritable, with unwritable expected 0 and awaiting-target 0; any non-zero awaiting-target is listed by row and explained in smoke.md
repo.stats for this repository shows completeness with its reasons and counts; the CLI, the JetBrains RepoStatusDialog and the VS Code Daemon tab show it
the record of the run is written to the Story folder's smoke.md
after the reindex: the doc-summarise-repo job for this repository runs to completion and the repository's summaries are present again (count before and after recorded in smoke.md)

callers in test files (__tests__ or *.test.ts) are counted apart: runGrepSearch's calls from grep-core.test.ts and grep-omitted.test.ts, if stored, are reported separately and do not change the measure of 4, which the issue states for production call sites
